info.title: pefix
info.description: Zero-false-positive static loadability preflight for .NET publish, plugin, and Unity/BepInEx folders. Catches missing references, version conflicts, missing members/types/interfaces, broken native and reflection loads, and BepInEx plugin issues before a host loads the assemblies. Single Native-AOT binary, no .NET runtime.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
pefix is a single-binary CLI that runs a zero-false-positive static loadability preflight over folders of .NET assemblies (publish, plugin, Unity/BepInEx) and selectively repairs PE-header portability in place.
Run `pefix <verb> --help` for verb-specific options.
Exit codes:
0  Success or no gate triggered
1  Failure-on-gate triggered, refusal, or non-compatible result
2  Usage error
4  IO error

commands.name: closure
commands.description: Walks the transitive AssemblyRef graph and reports unresolved dependency chains.

options.name: --fail-on-unresolved
options.description: Exit with code 1 when any transitive dependency is unresolved.

options.name: --tree
options.description: Include the full transitive dependency tree.

options.name: --orphans
options.description: List managed assemblies that no other scanned assembly references. Advisory output for trimming deployment folders; entry points, BepInEx plugins, satellite assemblies, and reflection-named assemblies are not listed.

options.name: --dgml
options.description: Emit the dependency graph as DGML (Directed Graph Markup Language) to stdout, viewable in Visual Studio. Implies the full tree.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Apply the safe PE header fix. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.

options.name: --no-backup
options.description: Skip .bak file creation. Only meaningful with --apply.

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow patching cautioned assemblies. Only meaningful with --apply.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to fix.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 when the result meets or exceeds the given severity.

commands.name: pinvoke
commands.description: List P/Invoke calls in a managed assembly or directory.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to inspect.

commands.name: publicise
commands.description: Publicize types/methods/fields in a managed assembly. Default dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the file. Without this flag the run is dry-run only.

commands.name: redir
commands.description: Rewrite AssemblyRef version fields. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to redirect.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scans a folder of managed assemblies for loadability and dependency issues.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 when the result meets or exceeds the given severity.

options.name: --fail-on-conflict
options.description: Exit with code 1 when version conflicts are detected.

options.name: --fail-on-issue
options.description: Exit with code 1 when any blocking directory issue or unsafe/corrupt file diagnosis is found. Use as a CI gate on publish/plugin folders.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Static host/artifact profile assumptions. Supported: unity-bepinex, unity-bepinex5, unity-bepinex6-mono, unity-bepinex6-il2cpp, dotnet-plugin, publish-dir.

options.name: --references
options.description: Include a reference inventory in text output and JSON.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Baseline file of accepted issue lines. Exit with code 1 when a blocking issue is not in the baseline; baselined issues are still reported but do not fail the gate.

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description: Write the current blocking issue lines to the --baseline path instead of gating, then exit 0.

commands.name: snstrip
commands.description: Strip strong-name signing. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write changes to disk. Without this flag, the command only reports what would change.

options.name: --force
options.description: Strip even when InternalsVisibleTo uses a signed PublicKey.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Assembly file or directory to strip.
